narrative.intro: Honeywell Federal Manufacturing and Technologies obligated $2.1B in federal contract obligations in FY2026 to date. The company has one award recorded this fiscal year, with an average award size of $2.1B. Obligations are up 0.3% year over year. Historical obligations show a pattern: FY21 was $1.7B, FY22 was $2B, FY23 was $1.8B, FY24 was $1.8B, FY25 was $2.1B, and FY26 is $2.1B so far. The current-year totals are partial because the fiscal year is ongoing. The reporting distinguishes contract obligations from total contract values in the largest-awards and expiring-contracts tables, noting that award-value figures in those tables are total contract values rather than obligations. Use these figures to compare scale and year-to-date performance, and remember that the FY2026 total is a fiscal year to date number, not a full-year total.
